first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The upright person on the central Light-Colored Bare Soil Patch, wearing a light-colored top and dark trousers, with dark hair hanging to the shoulders and one arm raised.

entities.name: Animal A
entities.identification: The brownish-yellow dog-like animal on the image-left side of Person A; its head, body, and part of its legs are initially visible, and it clearly overlaps with Person A's legs in the later portion.

entities.name: Golden Dry Grassland
entities.identification: The broad Golden Dry Grassland of short golden to yellowish-brown grass occupying the foreground and most of the middle ground.

entities.name: Mixed Woodland Belt
entities.identification: The woodland belt at the far end of the grassland, composed of dark green, pointed-crown trees and yellow-green and brownish-green, broad-crown trees.

entities.name: Sky
entities.identification: The pale blue to nearly white Sky visible above and between the tree crowns.

entities.name: Light-Colored Bare Soil Patch
entities.identification: The light grayish-yellow ground patch beneath Person A and Animal A, with irregular edges and sparse grass within it.

entities.name: Low Grassy Mound
entities.identification: The broad, gently sloping low mound behind Person A and in front of the woodland, its surface covered with short golden grass.

entities.name: Cluster of Gray-Brown Rocks
entities.identification: The low, irregular gray-brown rocks scattered behind and to the image-right of Person A and near the woodland edge.

entities.name: Tall Dry Grass at the Woodland Edge
entities.identification: The clusters of relatively tall yellowish-brown grass near the woodland edge in the image-right background.

entities.name: Woodland-Edge Ground Area
entities.identification: The sparsely vegetated grayish-yellow to gray-brown ground area between the rocks and grass clumps near the woodland edge in the image-right background.
